# cargo offrails generate page about
# options: {"nav": "no", "path": "/about"}

=== shared src/controllers/pages.rs
//! Static pages (`generate page`): About, Pricing, Terms… Public, no data.

use axum::response::{IntoResponse, Response};

use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::views::{self, Ctx, pages};

// samples: page actions

=== wire src/controllers/mod.rs @ samples: controller mods (for src/controllers/pages.rs)
pub mod pages;

=== wire src/controllers/pages.rs @ samples: page actions
/// `GET /about` (`cargo offrails generate page about`)
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn about(ctx: Ctx) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    // APP: a description for search results and link previews.
    Ok(views::render(pages::PagesAbout {
        ctx: ctx.titled("About"),
    })?
    .into_response())
}


=== shared src/views/pages.rs
//! Page structs for the static pages (`generate page`).

use askama::Template;

use super::Ctx;
// The layout links with `paths::`.
use crate::routes::paths;

// samples: page views

=== wire src/views/mod.rs @ samples: view mods (for src/views/pages.rs)
pub mod pages;

=== wire src/views/pages.rs @ samples: page views
/// `GET /about`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "pages/about.html")]
pub struct PagesAbout {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
}

}

=== shared tests/app/pages_test.rs
//! The static pages (`generate page`): each renders, publicly, and is in the sitemap.

use offrails_app::routes::paths;

use crate::support::TestApp;

// samples: page tests

=== wire tests/app/main.rs @ samples: test mods (for tests/app/pages_test.rs)
mod pages_test;

=== wire tests/app/pages_test.rs @ samples: page tests
#[tokio::test]
async fn about_renders_publicly_and_is_in_the_sitemap() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.get(&paths::about())
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_contains("<title>About · ")
        .assert_text("About");
    app.get("/sitemap.xml")
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_contains(&format!("{}</loc>", paths::about()));
}
